contact.basis: Unmodified public elevation field at the pavilion approach on the Danya Hill crown.

verticalDatum: EGM2008 from the original Copernicus GLO-30 elevation tile.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus DEM data from the GLO-30 public dataset, resampled by Molen. European Union and Airbus Defence and Space.
method: Original unaltered GLO-30 tile values bilinearly sampled at pixel centers in the fixed site frame. Sampling and 16-bit encoding apply no flattening, terrain fitting or masking.
limitations: The 30 m source is a surface elevation model. Its elevation is approximate on the cliff and can include modern buildings and vegetation. The 2 m review grid does not increase source resolution.
The first Terrarium test exhibited isolated depths below −600 m at the coast; its numerical samples were discarded and are recorded in the scratch acquisition results.
